description: Given one input, \(T=p\uparrow(p\uparrow p)\) is always true and \(T\uparrow T\) is always false, while \(F=p\downarrow(p\downarrow p)\) is always false and \(F\downarrow F\) is always true; these witnesses use no constants.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.gate_constant_witnesses.{u} {α : Type u} (a : α)
  (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation α) :
  have p := Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.SingleGateFormula.atom a;
  have T := p.gate (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.gateNeg p);
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.gateEval Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.GateKind.nand v T =
      true ∧
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.gateEval Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.GateKind.nand v
          (T.gate T) =
        false ∧
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.gateEval Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.GateKind.nor v T =
          false ∧
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.gateEval Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.GateKind.nor v
            (T.gate T) =
          true
